acceptanceCriteria.text: Identify exactly which declared bin(s) fail the shared smoke probe and document the intended executable contract for each.

Align `mottainai`, `mtnai`, and `mottainai-mcp` with the package-validation contract, or configure/extend the shared CI contract so MCP stdio entrypoints are validated with an appropriate bounded smoke test.
Do not start a long-lived MCP stdio server as an accidental consequence of `--help`/`--version` validation.
The packed tarball installs successfully in a clean temporary package.
Add regression coverage for the declared-bin smoke contract so future bin additions cannot silently break shared CI.

issue.title: fix: make packed CLI smoke validation compatible with declared bin entrypoints
